verdicts.reason: A: the original pill shapes are lost. The CTA and flavour tags are now square-cornered rectangles, which goes off brand. The CTA floats right of the left-aligned text column for no clear reason. The tags line up neither with the text column (x≈79 vs 47) nor with each other, and HONEY ROSEMARY is centred on its own row. CUCUMBER MINT overlaps the peach circle. B: it keeps the rounded pill CTA and tags and has a cleaner edge (the right edge of CUCUMBER MINT matches the CTA). However, the tags' left edge (~108) doesn't line up with the text column (~88), the CTA is still oddly offset, and 'here' runs close to the right edge. Both have weak grid logic, and B is more faithful.
